== Notes ==
* Re-applying this enchantment while it is active will cause you to lose all enchantments, including this one, thereby triggering the health loss.
* Consider [[Glyph of Essence]] or [[Ether Lord]], or a low-energy [[weapon swap]] to hide energy, to counter the health loss.
